title: 小鳄鱼爱洗澡
subtitle: WHERE'S MY WATER?
description: 挖开泥土，把清水引进小鳄鱼的浴缸。规划一条好路线，别忘了沿途的小鸭子。
coverAlt: 小鳄鱼爱洗澡关卡：让水穿过泥土，流进浴缸

en.title: Where’s My Water?
en.subtitle: WHERE’S MY WATER?
en.description: Dig through the dirt and guide clean water into Swampy’s bathtub. Plan a clever route and collect the ducks along the way.
en.coverAlt: Where’s My Water? level with water, dirt, ducks, and Swampy in his bathtub

title: 割绳子
subtitle: CUT THE ROPE
description: 看准时机，轻轻一剪。收集星星，让糖果落进 Om Nom 的嘴里，开启一场甜蜜冒险。
coverAlt: 割绳子关卡：悬挂的糖果、三颗星星和等待投喂的 Om Nom

en.title: Cut the Rope
en.subtitle: CUT THE ROPE
en.description: Time your cuts, collect the stars, and feed the candy to Om Nom. A sweet little adventure is waiting.
en.coverAlt: Cut the Rope level with hanging candy, three stars, and Om Nom waiting below

title: 窄道停车
subtitle: NARROW PARKING
description: 慢慢转向，稳稳停车。在狭窄路段控制好速度，挑战你的驾驶与停车技巧。
coverAlt: 窄道停车游戏画面：在狭窄道路中驾驶并寻找停车位置

en.title: Narrow Parking
en.subtitle: NARROW PARKING
en.description: Find your line, keep a steady speed, and ease into tight parking spots. A little patience goes a long way.
en.coverAlt: Narrow Parking gameplay with a car navigating narrow roads and parking spaces

title: 化妆解压
subtitle: 轻松护理，随心上妆
description: 跟随画面提示，清洁护理、挑选妆容。慢慢完成每一个小步骤，享受轻松的化妆时光。
coverAlt: 化妆解压游戏封面：人物面部护理与化妆

title: 吃苹果的蛇
subtitle: SNAKE TO EAT
description: 吃苹果、长身体，绕过障碍与悬崖。动动脑筋，让灵活的小蛇抵达出口。
coverAlt: 吃苹果的蛇：小蛇、苹果与方块平台

en.title: Snake to Eat
en.subtitle: SNAKE TO EAT
en.description: Eat apples, grow longer, and work your way around tricky obstacles. Help a hungry snake reach the exit.
en.coverAlt: Snake to Eat with a snake, apples, and block platforms

title: 缠绕的绳子
subtitle: ROPE TANGLE PUZZLE
description: 理清交错的绳索，慢慢解开眼前的结。跟随画面提示，寻找解结的顺序。
coverAlt: 缠绕的绳子游戏封面：交错的彩色绳索

en.title: Rope Tangle Puzzle
en.subtitle: ROPE TANGLE PUZZLE
en.description: Follow each strand, untangle the knots, and work out a clever order. Take your time with a colorful rope puzzle.
en.coverAlt: Rope Tangle Puzzle cover with tangled colorful ropes

title: 80亿分之1
subtitle: 1 IN 8 BILLION
description: 在世界的某个角落出生，经历选择、相遇与成长。用另一种人生，看看不一样的世界。
coverAlt: 80亿分之1：地球轮廓、人生轨迹与代表不同人生的人物

en.title: 1 in 8 Billion
en.subtitle: 1 IN 8 BILLION
en.description: Be born somewhere in the world, make choices, and meet the people who shape a lifetime. See the world through another life.
en.coverAlt: 1 in 8 Billion with an abstract globe, a lifetime path, and people representing different lives

title: 植物大战僵尸
subtitle: PLANTS VS. ZOMBIES
description: 收集阳光，种下豌豆射手和向日葵。建立植物防线，守住你的小院。
coverAlt: 植物大战僵尸：向日葵、豌豆射手与来袭的僵尸

en.title: Plants vs. Zombies
en.subtitle: PLANTS VS. ZOMBIES
en.description: Gather sunshine, plant peashooters and sunflowers, and build a leafy defense to protect your garden.
en.coverAlt: Plants vs. Zombies with a sunflower, peashooter, and approaching zombies

title: 双人厨房
subtitle: DOUBLE KITCHEN
description: 选择双人合作或双人对决，和朋友一起制作餐点、招待客人，挑战忙碌的厨房。
coverAlt: 双人厨房游戏封面：拟人食物角色与游戏标题

en.title: Double Kitchen
en.subtitle: DOUBLE KITCHEN
en.description: Team up or compete with a friend. Prepare food, serve hungry customers, and take on a busy kitchen together.
en.coverAlt: Double Kitchen cover with cartoon food characters and the game title

title: 这关很解压
subtitle: LEVEL RELAXATION
description: 点击、拖动，解开各式各样的小谜题。仔细观察画面，慢慢找到每一关的答案。
coverAlt: 这关很解压原版游戏封面

en.title: Level Relaxation
en.subtitle: LEVEL RELAXATION
en.description: Tap, drag, and solve a variety of little puzzles. Look closely and find each answer at your own pace.
